tools.name: convert_to_csv
tools.description: Convert a table to CSV without changing any value; verified by round-trip. Costs $0.05 USDC (x402).

tools.name: deduplicate
tools.description: Remove duplicate rows by exact key, keeping the first or last, and report conflicting columns per group. Costs $0.05 USDC (x402).

tools.name: reconcile
tools.description: Compare two versions of a table by key: rows added, removed and changed (with the changed columns). Costs $0.05 USDC (x402).

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verify an on-chain payment without trusting any RPC: did this tx transfer at least this amount of a token (default USDC) to this payee, optionally from this payer? tools.name: try_verify_payment
tools.description: Free: the same verification as verify_payment, limited to 3 NEW claims per client per day (asking again about a claim already checked is always free).

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Free. Current state of a verification by checkId; re-checks it once its retry or challenge time has passed.

tools.name: watch_verification
tools.description: Free for a PAID check: add a callback (https) that receives signed events when requiredLevel is reached, when the answer changes, when it becomes final, or when checking gives up. The service re-checks on its own.

tools.name: verify_payments_batch
tools.description: Verify up to 25 payments in one call for $0.25 USDC (x402): give `claims` (same fields as verify_payment) or `csv` (header: chain,txHash,payee,token,minAmountRaw,payer,logIndex). tools.name: get_verifications
tools.description: Free. Up to 50 checks at once (re-checked when due), as rows; format "csv" adds a reconciliation CSV.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Free. Status and (once verified) the result of a paid job, using the accessToken its paid call returned.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "verify_payment" is 756 chars, far longer than this server's median (129). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
